offering_description.value: Franchisor of on-demand temporary staffing offices that supply light industrial, skilled trade, and general labor workers to businesses. Franchisees run local offices and place workers; the company collects royalties and provides franchise support and back-office services.

primary_services.value: temporary staffing; on-demand labor placement; franchise support services; payroll and back-office services for franchisees; direct hire placement

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses needing temporary labor in construction, light industrial, manufacturing, hospitality and similar sectors; B2B: franchisees who pay royalties and fees to operate staffing offices

end_markets.value: construction; light industrial; manufacturing; warehousing and logistics; hospitality; skilled trades

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: franchise royalties based on franchisee system sales; service fees: staffing fees and service revenue from company-owned offices and franchisee support
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: franchisor and staffing provider placing temporary workers with business clients through franchised offices

geography_served.value: US national: franchised offices across many US states

specialization.value: niche specialist: franchised temporary staffing with related brands for blue-collar labor

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: franchisees operating local staffing offices under company brands; direct sales: company-owned offices and national account sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: employment, wage and hour, workers' compensation, and franchise regulations (FTC, DOL, state laws)
